Master toggle for ocean and beach (shoreline) waves. Turn off if you only want river waves, or no waves at all.
wavify.configuration.chunk_radius.toolti: The chunk radius of chunks that should spawn waves. Reduce this number if you're struggling for performance!
wavify.configuration.chunk_updates_resca: The amount of block updates that should happen in a chunk before it is rescanned for wave spawning.
wavify.configuration.spawn_distance.tool: How many blocks out from the shore waves try to spawn.
wavify.configuration.debug.tooltip: Helpful for figuring out where waves are spawning, and how. Hold a spyglass to see debug waves on spawn, keep one in your hotbar to see all scanned water blocks, hold a compass for wave directions, and put a clock in your offhand for wave spawn positions.
wavify.configuration.lake_wave_multiplie: Scales down waves that spawn on inland water bodies.
wavify.configuration.apply_transparency_: Applies the transparency slider to the foam as well as the wave body.
Darkens the ground where a wave washes up, as if the sand got wet. Turn off to disable the effect entirely.
wavify.configuration.color_source.toolti: Whether wave tinting uses biome water colors or the custom color below.
wavify.configuration.custom_color.toolti: Custom wave color, used when Color Source is set to CUSTOM.
wavify.configuration.biome_color_overrid: Comma separated biome=color overrides, for example minecraft:luke_warm_ocean=3F76E4.
wavify.configuration.wave_y_offset.toolt: Shifts the whole wave (body and foam) up or down. Applied in both vanilla and shader modes. Negative = lower.
Only applied when an Iris/Oculus shaderpack is active. Sinks the wave body below water so the shaderpack's water reflections render on top. More negative = waves sit deeper. 0 disables shader compensation.
Master toggle for river waves. Turn off if you don't want waves on rivers.
wavify.configuration.river_wave_spawn_ra: Radius (in blocks) around you within which river waves spawn. Larger = waves appear further away; smaller = only close by.
Roughly how many river waves appear per 100 river water blocks near you.
wavify.configuration.river_wave_travel_b: How far (in blocks) a river wave travels down the channel before fading out.
Plays a looping ambient ocean sound when ocean waves are nearby, and a river sound when river waves are nearby. Sounds fade in/out smoothly.
wavify.configuration.wave_sound_volume.t: Master volume multiplier for the ocean and river ambient loops.
